description.html: Gecko Nutrition Strawberry is a complete powdered diet for crested geckos, made in Germany. Strawberry gives it an aromatic, sweet taste that geckos accept readily, and together with banana and insects it makes a balanced meal.

The main ingredients are banana 28%, insects 11% (black soldier fly larvae, mealworms and crickets) and strawberry 10%, complemented by whey protein and casein, pea protein, whole grain rice, coconut, bee pollen, honey, carrot, beetroot and spirulina. Vitamins A, D3 and B vitamins are added, along with iron, selenium and manganese.

Mix 1 part powder with 2 parts water (by volume). The mix is runny at first but thickens within a few minutes to a ketchup-like consistency; you can adjust the ratio slightly. The manufacturer recommends feeding 2-3 evenings a week, and leftovers should be removed after 24 hours. Store the opened pack in a cool, dry place; prepared food keeps 3-4 days in the fridge.
Besides crested geckos, it also suits other fruit-eating reptiles. Read more about feeding on our lizard food page.

Order by phone or WhatsApp message. Fast courier delivery. Customers in Novi Sad can pick up their order directly at our workshop. Contact us with any questions about the product or for a recommendation for your species.
